{{Top|leg}}
The '''TZ-2 transport''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] class that was the basis for the smaller [[TZ-24 Enforcer]], a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was designed before the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
